# daily.dev

> A personalized developer news platform and browser extension that delivers curated tech content, hiring opportunities, and B2B advertising to software engineers worldwide.

daily.dev is a Chrome extension and web platform that serves as the homepage for developers, aggregating news, articles, and resources tailored to individual interests. The platform also offers B2B services including a recruiter marketplace and advertising capabilities for reaching the developer community.

- developer community

## Core Platform

- [daily.dev | Developer news today for software engineers](https://daily.dev): Main landing page showcasing daily.dev's personalized developer news platform
- [daily.dev | The homepage developers deserve - Chrome Web Store](https://api.daily.dev/get): Chrome extension download page for daily.dev personalized developer feed
- [daily.dev | The homepage developers deserve - Chrome Web Store](https://r.daily.dev/chrome): Redirect to Chrome Web Store for daily.dev browser extension

## Business & Hiring Solutions

- [daily.dev for Business | Marketing & Advertising on...](https://business.daily.dev): B2B advertising platform for reaching developers on daily.dev
- [daily.dev Recruiter | The Developer-First Hiring Platform](https://recruiter.daily.dev): Developer hiring platform built on daily.dev's trusted community
